note: rapport de gestion du 10-Q de Microsoft du 28 janvier 2026 (trimestre clos le 31 décembre 2025) : partenariat stratégique depuis 2019, prolongé par l'accord définitif d'octobre 2025 ; Microsoft, investisseur majeur ; accords réciproques de partage de revenus ; droits sur la propriété intellectuelle d'OpenAI (modèles et infrastructure) ; aucun montant
quote: We have a long-term strategic partnership with OpenAI which was originally established in 2019. In October 2025, we signed a new definitive agreement with OpenAI that extends this partnership and continues to build on our shared vision to advance artificial intelligence responsibly and make its benefits broadly accessible. Microsoft is a major investor in OpenAI, and the companies have reciprocal revenue-sharing arrangements. We hold rights to OpenAI's intellectual property, including models and infrastructure, for integration into our products.
